RaCInG: Random Cell-cell Interaction Generator

Source: R/RaCInG-package.R
RaCInG-package.Rd

RaCInG provides functions to prepare ligand-receptor input matrices, generate patient-specific communication graphs, derive kernel or Monte Carlo features, and perform downstream statistical analysis.
